g.text: Magneticraft2 • Foundry Sand Mixer K1
Bronze III | 3 × 2 × 3 blocks | model pixels relative to front controller | orthographic guide
FRONT ELEVATION • open trough, axial mixing paddles
SOUTH blueprint (rear → front)
PPP
PAP
PPP
SIS
USO
SCS
TOP layer, Y1
BASE layer, Y0
I = Gear V2 rear input • U = item input • O = output
C = controller • S = stone bricks • P = oak planks
A = required AIR; covered by formed renderer only
Processing: 4 spent molding sand + 1 clay → 1 pre-blend → 3 reclaimed molding sand
Mechanical requirements: ≥12 RPM / 4 torque / 200 powered ticks / paddles 512 mixes
Mixing shaft pivot = (8,24,-4). Rear input shaft pivot = (8,8,-24). Both rotate about local Z.
This vector sheet is an EDITABLE DESIGN GUIDE, not a baked Minecraft block model.
The accompanying JSON is the canonical editable geometric V2 source; concept illustration is not a construction plan.
